releases.name: Fledly 0.4.0
releases.body:
- Gemini CLI context file GEMINI.md
- 13 workflow skills, including fledly-my-numbers and fledly-ai-visibility
- Hosted MCP server https://fledly.app/mcp with OAuth sign-in (a free Fledly account works)

releases.name: Fledly 0.2.0
releases.body:
Fledly agent packages: Claude Code plugin, Cursor plugin, Hermes Agent and Agent Plugins package, the opencode-fledly npm package, a shared skill and now a Gemini CLI extension. All connect to the hosted Fledly MCP server at https://fledly.app/mcp with OAuth sign-in.

Gemini CLI: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/synthentica/fledly`, then `/mcp auth fledly`.
